name: AI Entries
author: berchj

sections.description:
This plugin relies on third-party services for generating AI content, media manipulation, and fetching news articles. It uses the Google GEMINI API, Stability AI, and News API for its functionalities.

To use this plugin you must obtain API keys from all services:

  • GEMINI API: You need a GEMINI API KEY, which you can get for free here.

    • Service URL: https://ai.google.dev/
    • Terms of Use: Google API Terms
    • Privacy Policy: Google API Privacy

  • Stability AI API: You also need a Stability.ai API KEY, available for free here.

    • Service URL: https://stability.ai/
    • Terms of Use: Stability AI Terms
    • Privacy Policy: Stability AI Privacy

  • News API: You need a News API KEY, which you can get for free here.

    • Service URL: https://newsapi.org
    • Privacy Policy: News API Privacy
    • Terms of Use: News API Terms

Please note that the performance and availability of functionalities depend on these APIs, and usage is subject to their respective terms and conditions.
sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Plugin Check.
  3. Install and activate the Plugin.
sections.faq:
Where can I contribute or report bugs of this plugin?

This is an open source project . All development for this plugin is handled via GitHub. Any issues or pull requests should be posted there.

Why aren’t all posts always created?

The functionality of this plugin depends on external systems accessed through HTTP calls. The performance of the plugin may be affected by the free API keys and the limitations or changes in the service provided by these APIs.
